---
title: "Codebook"
---

## hai_directed_v0.1.csv

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| from_iso3, to_iso3 | ISO3 code of the origin and the target place |
| from_cow, to_cow | Correlates of War code |
| from_dummy, to_dummy | Invented extra ID (dummy) |
| year | Calendar year |
| hai_score | Score between 0 and 1 (invented) |
| hai_stock | Accumulated score (invented) |

## hai_dyad_counts_v0.1.csv

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| n_visits | Number of visits in that year |
| sources | Which sources the count comes from |

## Notes

- Places that are not one of the four are dropped.
- Unknown visits cannot be handled.
- The HAI measures closeness towards a place. It is not a formal tie.
